# Agile CRM

Agile CRM combines contact management, sales pipelines, marketing automation, tasks, campaigns, and customer support in one platform.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/agile-crm/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact or Company**: Create a person contact with optional tags and scoring, or a company, with common and tenant custom properties.
- **Create Deal**: Create a deal, optionally associate contacts, and validate or resolve a case-sensitive milestone from the selected or default pipeline.
- **Delete Contact or Company**: Permanently delete one person contact or company by numeric ID.
- **Delete Deal**: Permanently delete one deal by its numeric Agile CRM ID.
- **Get Contact or Company** (read-only): Get one person contact or company by its numeric Agile CRM ID.
- **Get Deal** (read-only): Get one deal by its numeric Agile CRM ID.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): Return one creation-ordered page of person contacts, with a cursor for the next page when more contacts exist.
- **List Deals** (read-only): Return one creation-ordered page of deals, with a cursor for the next page when more deals exist.
- **Update Contact or Company**: Add or replace selected properties on one person contact or company without replacing properties that are not included.
- **Update Deal**: Partially update selected fields of an existing deal without replacing fields that are not supplied.
